documents.name: Corporate Constitution (June 2020)
documents.text: Constitution of PivotStack Pte Ltd, adopted 3 June 2020. The company is a private company limited by shares; the directors may allot shares with the approval of the members in general meeting; the board shall consist of not fewer than one director; general meetings are convened and conducted in accordance with the Companies Act; the company may but need not have a common seal.

documents.name: Master Services Agreement — Portside (2024)
documents.text: 7. DATA PROTECTION. 7.1 Each party shall comply with the Personal Data Protection Act 2012. 7.2 Data Incident Notice: the Service Provider shall notify the Customer of any data breach affecting Customer Personal Data no later than 3 calendar days after becoming aware of the breach, and shall in the same period notify the Personal Data Protection Commission where the breach is assessed to be notifiable. 7.3 The Service Provider shall maintain reasonable security arrangements. 12. LIABILITY. 12.1 Aggregate liability is capped at fees paid in the preceding 12 months.

documents.name: Data Processing Addendum v2
documents.text: 4. BREACH NOTIFICATION. 4.1 The Processor shall notify the Controller within 3 calendar days of becoming aware of any incident that may constitute a personal data breach. 4.2 The Controller shall assess whether the breach is notifiable; no time limit is specified for completing that assessment. 4.3 The Processor shall provide reasonable assistance with any notification to the Commission. 5. SUB-PROCESSORS. 5.1 The Processor may engage the sub-processors listed in Schedule 2, and shall flow down obligations no less protective than this Addendum, provided that sub-processors shall notify the Processor within 5 business days of becoming aware of an incident.
